excerpts.text: - The second run's tap covered the bind. 99.6 ms after the bind command, the peer sent PROBE_TX (IEEE 1722.1's CONNECT_TX) for its own talker onto the network, and again 200 ms later. Nothing answered in the rest of the capture, 49.6 s, so the stream never started.

- B0, the DUT on INTERNAL with both of the peer's talkers bound, 300 s at McASP0: THD+N -123.95 dB at 997 Hz and -122.80 dB at 9,973 Hz (median), SNR the same, 0 discontinuities, 0.0000 ppm. The floor blocks' medians are -123.98 dB and -123.95 dB. 131 of the 300 blocks at the TDM output sit off the floor, with no discontinuity.

- the earlier probes give round 8's readings byte for byte, but for R624-7's `footnote_ref_and` form: its footnote definition, appended after the page's last line, is named at line 4424 instead of 4274, because the page grew;
